page_title: GEN 2-2 BOL | Genoa v Bologna 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+1' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Riccardo Orsolini leaves the pitch and is replaced by Emil Holm (Bologna).
90' Daniele Doveri blows for a foul after David Ankeye (Genoa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
86' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

85' 2 - 2 Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) outjumps the defence in the centre of the box and connects with the free kick from Aaron Martin. He sends the ball into the top left corner with his towering header and alters the score to 2:2.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Morten Frendrup trots off the pitch and is replaced by David Ankeye (Genoa).
81' Remo Freuler (Bologna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
80' Genoa are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
78' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Remo Freuler (Bologna). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
76' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Jens Odgaard will be replaced by Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna).
76' It's time for a substitution. Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) comes on in place of Santiago Castro.
75' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
73' 1 - 2 Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
73' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
70' Santiago Castro (Bologna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
70' The referee blows his whistle as Patrizio Masini (Genoa) was too aggressive in his challenge.
69' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) commits a rough foul. Daniele Doveri stops the game and makes a call.
67' Santiago Castro (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
66' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
65' Substitution. Fabio Miretti will be replaced by Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa).
65' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a change. Patrizio Masini (Genoa) replaces Morten Thorsby.
64' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Aaron Martin (Genoa) for his blatant foul.
63' The game has come to an end for Benjamin Dominguez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jesper Karlsson (Bologna).
61' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
59' 2:8 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.

56' 0 - 2 Jens Odgaard (Bologna) picks up a rebound just outside the box, steadies himself and unleashes a shot that deflects off the post into the bottom right corner, beating the helpless goalkeeper.
56' Juan Miranda (Bologna) works the corner short.
53' A cross from Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
52' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
50' Aaron Martin (Genoa) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Federico Ravaglia.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) comes off for Brooke Norton-Cuffy.
46' Alberto Gilardino makes a switch. Jeff Ekhator is coming on in place of Filippo Melegoni (Genoa) at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the left post. He should have scored!
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Aaron Martin (Genoa) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar.
41' Alberto Gilardino is stunned as referee Daniele Doveri shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
40' Bologna keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.

37' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) displays superb quick feet and dribbling as he jinks his way through multiple challenges and takes a shot from inside the box, which is deflected and goes past stranded Nicola Leali. 0:1.
37' The Bologna players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
36' Goal, no wait. Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for handball and Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) can't celebrate. Disallowed goal.
35' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) makes a slide tackle, but referee Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
33' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
32' The free kick is taken by Aaron Martin (Genoa), but ball is cleared.
29' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle. Morten Thorsby (Genoa) commits a foul after dangerous play.
28' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
28' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is quickest to the rebound and shoots towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him. Bologna have a corner.
26' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
25' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.

24' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Nicola Leali pulls off an easy save.
23' The possession of the ball – 26:74.
21' Aaron Martin (Genoa) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
20' It's a nice effort by Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Federico Ravaglia. Easy save.
18' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
17' Daniele Doveri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Johan Vasquez (Genoa).
15' The resulting corner from Juan Miranda (Bologna) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
15' Sam Beukema (Bologna) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Nicola Leali makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the right side of the goal.
15' Juan Miranda (Bologna) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

15' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Nicola Leali was alert and the score remains the same. Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.
14' Juan Miranda (Bologna) takes the corner with a short pass.
13' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
12' Juan Miranda (Bologna) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
10' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
9' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
6' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nicola Leali intercepts the ball.
4' Federico Ravaglia saves his team from danger as he rises high to pluck the ball out of the air from a free kick by Aaron Martin (Genoa).
3' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
2' Bologna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
1' The match has just started.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Daniele Doveri was nominated as the referee for this game.
